Yes, absolutely. But to get the lips fully numb it's several injections and then 
the patient is numb for several hours. Whereas the topical will wear off 
typically in 30 min or so. The tip of all modern HA fillers, also, is filled 
with lidocaine which will make the lip go numb upon the first "poke", so usually 
that's the most they will feel. But again, if you absolutely need the nerve 
block we will 100% make it work for you! We want the patient to be calm and 
comfortable. (although, personally, the nerve block hurts much more than the 
actual injections!)
